title: The sign-in tests lock in 'Wait 15 minutes' though the PIN lock can last 1 hour
what: After too many wrong PINs the sign-in page says to wait 15 minutes. The server makes the third lock in a day last 1 hour, and the server test checks that. The browser tests require the 15-minute words, so a person locked for an hour is told to come back in 15 minutes, tries again, and is still locked. The journey's own lock line is never checked.
expected: The lock words say how long the lock really lasts (or only 'wait a little'), and a test checks the words for a 1-hour lock.
who: owners and desk people whose PIN is guessed at
how_often: from the third lock in a day
fix_line: Word the lock message from the lock time the server sends, and test it with a 1-hour lock

title: No test checks that one PIN works in every branch, or that a changed PIN stops the old one
what: The PIN tests only use a second, unrelated gym. No test sets a PIN for an owner with two branches and signs in to the other branch, and no test signs in with the old PIN after a PIN change. Both are promised by the journeys.
expected: A server test sets a PIN in branch A, signs in to branch B with it, then changes it and proves the old PIN is refused in both.
fix_line: Add a branch PIN check and an old-PIN-after-change check to the PIN test

title: The Pro-only lock on body measurements and diet plans is never tested
what: The server blocks new body measurements and diet plans for a gym not on Pro, but the plan test checks the lock only for the shop, branding, workout plans and challenges. A change that drops the lock on these two would pass.
expected: The plan test also tries a measurement and a diet plan on a Starter gym and sees the Pro-only refusal.
who: gyms on Starter, and MettleUp's income
how_often: once the plan switch is on
fix_line: Add a measurement and a diet plan to the Pro-only part of the plan test

title: The timings test never checks late-night hours of yesterday or that members cannot see who changed the hours
what: The timings test drops a special day that is 5 days old, but never one from yesterday whose hours run past midnight. It also never checks that the member's read leaves out who last changed the hours; today the code leaves it out, but nothing keeps it so.
expected: The test saves yesterday's late special day and checks it still shows tonight, and checks the member read has no name of who changed the hours.
fix_line: Add a yesterday-past-midnight special day and a no-name check on the member read to the timings test

title: No test shows the desk which members are hidden from the leaderboard
what: The leaderboard test checks the owner's board marks hidden members, and that the desk cannot hide anyone. It never checks that the desk's board marks a hidden member.
expected: The test reads the desk's board after the owner hides a member and sees the hidden mark.
fix_line: Check the hidden mark on the desk's board in the leaderboard test

title: Pop-up jobs are never tested for a failed job, a second job for one offer, or being cleared away
what: The pop-up test checks one job for a message and an offer job. It never shows that a message still sends when making its pop-up job fails, that saving the same offer twice makes only one job, or that finished jobs are deleted.
expected: Tests cover a failed job not blocking the send, one job per offer, and finished jobs deleted.
fix_line: Add the three cases to the pop-up test

title: No test checks a diet plan comes back when a membership is renewed
what: The diet test checks a member whose membership ended sees no plan sent by membership plan. It never renews that member and checks the plan comes back.
expected: The test renews the ended member and sees the plan again.
fix_line: Renew the ended member in the diet test and check the plan returns
